23 | 	sessions map[string]Session
24 | 	ttl      time.Duration

28 | // NewStore returns an empty store. Sessions idle for longer than ttl expire.
29 | func NewStore(ttl time.Duration) *Store {
30 | 	return &Store{
31 | 		sessions: map[string]Session{},
32 | 		ttl:      ttl,
33 | 		now:      time.Now,
34 | 	}

37 | // Create records a new session for a user.
38 | func (s *Store) Create(id string, user string) Session {
39 | 	s.mu.Lock()
40 | 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
41 | 	at := s.now()
42 | 	session := Session{ID: id, User: user, Created: at, LastSeen: at}
43 | 	s.sessions[id] = session
44 | 	return session
45 | }

47 | // Get returns a live session and refreshes its last-seen time. An expired
48 | // session is dropped and reported as missing.
49 | func (s *Store) Get(id string) (Session, error) {
50 | 	s.mu.Lock()
51 | 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
52 | 	session, ok := s.sessions[id]
53 | 	if !ok {
54 | 		return Session{}, ErrNotFound
55 | 	}
56 | 	if s.now().Sub(session.LastSeen) > s.ttl {
57 | 		delete(s.sessions, id)
58 | 		return Session{}, ErrNotFound
59 | 	}

61 | 	s.sessions[id] = session
62 | 	return session, nil
63 | }
